summary: U.S. GoldMining Inc. filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 522,876 shares of common stock at $7.65 per share, raising gross proceeds of up to $4.0 million. The offering is not a special situation; it is a routine capital markets transaction with no placement agent. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. No board recommendation, advisors, or strategic changes are mentioned. The filing is an ordinary equity raise under an existing shelf registration, not a going-private, tender offer, or other event-driven category.
